title: How to spot a steep trail on a map

scenes.headline: Spot the steep trail
scenes.narration: Two hikes can cover the same distance and feel completely different. The squiggly lines on your map tell you why.

scenes.headline: Read the contour lines
scenes.narration: Every point along one contour line is at the same height. The next line marks a different height.

definition.meaning: A line connecting places at the same elevation.

scenes.headline: Spacing shows steepness
scenes.narration: When the lines bunch up, elevation changes over a short distance. When they spread out, the ground is gentler.

scenes.headline: Check the map legend
scenes.narration: If the legend says twenty feet, that's the height difference between two neighboring contour lines on that map.

scenes.headline: Find the climb
scenes.narration: Open a topo map and trace your next trail. Can you spot where the lines get closest?
